item.title: Four arrested after alleged dark web drug purchases
item.description: ROCHESTER, Ind. -- On Tuesday, the Fulton County Sheriff's Office announced four arrests following a narcotics investigation, including one 18-year-old who allegedly purchased narcotics through the dark web.

item.title: All Nations Church hosts March Gladness family event
item.description: BERRIEN COUNTY, Mich. -- All Nations Seventh-day Adventist Church is hosting a free "March Gladness" event on Saturday in Berrien Springs, featuring family games and a basketball tournament.

item.title: Warsaw teen dead following Monday night shooting, suspect in custody
item.description: KOSCIUSKO COUNTY, Ind. -- The Kosciusko County Sheriff’s Office reports it's investigating a Monday night shooting that left a 15-year-old boy dead.

item.title: Suspect enters guilty plea agreement in pursuit, officer-involved shooting
item.description: KOSCIUSKO COUNTY, Ind. -- Court documents from Kosciusko County reveal the suspect in an officer-involved shooting from June 2025 entered a guilty plea agreement on Monday.

item.title: St. Joseph County Police Department offers home checks for Spring Break
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- The St. Joseph County Police Department is offering home checks to keep your home safe while you're away on vacation.

item.title: Colfax Avenue eastbound lane closed for water and sewer work
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The eastbound lane of Colfax Avenue from Niles Avenue to Hills Street will be closed the week of March 30 for water and sewer work.

item.title: Mayflower Bridge set to close beginning April 6
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Mayflower Bridge on South Bend's west side will be closed for about a month.

item.title: Notre Dame's Leonard Moore highlights student success and raises awareness of chronic absenteeism
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Fighting Irish college football cornerback, Lenard Moore, hosted an event on Sunday to bring awareness to the nationwide problem of chronic absenteeism, while also celebrating local student achievement by awarding two middle schoolers from the South Bend Community School Corporation.

item.title: Buchanan City Commission approves new playground equipment for Kathryn Park
item.description: BUCHANAN, Mich. -- The Buchanan City Commission approved the purchase of new playground equipment for $100,000 from Sinclair Recreation and Game Time during the March 23 Commissioners meeting.

item.title: Southwest Michigan Care Fund raises over $70K in three weeks
item.description: ST. JOSEPH, Mich. -- The United Way of Southwest Michigan announced within three weeks since activating the Southwest Michigan Cares Fund, total donations have passed $70,000 with more than 210 donors from across the region.

item.title: INDOT walks through a proposed diverging diamond intersection for S.R. 2 in New Carlisle
item.description: NEW CARLISLE, Ind. -- The Indiana Department of Transportation is proposing a major redesign of the intersection of S.R.2 and Larrison Boulevard in New Carlisle, aiming to ease congestion tied to growing industrial development in the area.

item.title: South Bend Community Review Board hosts open discussion on youth policies
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The South Bend Community Review Board held an open house and community conversation in order to introduce and converse with board members and office members to the residents of South Bend.

item.title: Trump ramps up threats, oil tanker struck: What we know on Day 32 of the US and Israel’s war with Iran
item.description: (CNN) — A Kuwaiti oil tanker was struck by what Kuwaitis said was an Iranian drone attack, as US President Donald Trump renewed his threat to blow up Iran’s oil facilities if it does not reopen the Hormuz strait. No oil leakage or injuries were reported following the strike on the tanker full of oil in Dubai waters, city authorities said.

item.title: Dozens killed as gang attacks ravage western Haiti ahead of international force’s arrival
item.description: (CNN) — Dozens of people have been killed and thousands forced to flee their homes after armed gangs ravaged Haiti’s major agricultural region soon before the expected arrival of an international force aimed at combating attacks like these.

item.title: DeSantis clears renaming of Florida airport after Trump for takeoff
item.description: (CNN) — Travelers in South Florida might soon find themselves transiting through Trump International Airport.
